title: Return received at warehouse
description: Confirm a returned parcel arrived at the warehouse and when the refund will be processed. Utility WhatsApp template. Copy it and adapt the brand.
notes: Use the return reference number and set a timeframe; do not mention exchange deals.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, we received your return *{{return_id}}* at our warehouse on {{date}}. It will be inspected and processed within {{days}} business days.
